question: Should `plugin-sdk/test-state` become a supported published Plugin SDK test contract, rather than keeping isolated state lifecycle fixtures repository-internal?
rationale: The consolidation needs a legal extension-test boundary, but a published SDK export constrains future fixture design and external plugin expectations beyond this one Telegram suite.

options.title: Confirm the narrow public test contract
options.body: Accept `plugin-sdk/test-state` as the supported isolated lifecycle seam and require its documented exports to remain intentionally compatible.

options.title: Keep state fixtures internal
options.body: Decline the public SDK addition and redesign the Telegram test harness around an existing public testing seam or a narrower owner-approved internal test pattern.

recommendation.title: Confirm the narrow public test contract
recommendation.body: Accept `plugin-sdk/test-state` as the supported isolated lifecycle seam and require its documented exports to remain intentionally compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch history shows this contributor introduced the proposed SDK seam and can provide the implementation context while the protected maintainer label routes final acceptance to repository owners.
